scope: real PostgreSQL and API orchestration with synthetic PDF fixtures; no OCR or provider call

checks.name: concurrent folder uploads share one workflow
claimed attempt reads its exact input revision
changed source updates the same workflow identity
only current materials appear in workflow detail
late old result cannot publish into current steps
new revision gets a new extraction attempt
project current-material count excludes historical revisions
failed entity check publishes no text or public artifact
failed extraction persists a private cache that cannot be downloaded
retry creates a new attempt rather than rewriting failed history
retry reuses failed attempt OCR with source and config fingerprints intact
recovery keeps the failed attempt and publishes only checked public outputs
